result.title: Posterior Matching Distillation
result.summary: Diffusion distillation accelerates image and video generation by compressing a pretrained teacher's iterative sampling process into a few network evaluations. Distribution-based methods achieve this by matching the student's output distribution to the teacher's. This matching is often driven by reverse-KL objectives, whose mode-seeking bias favors dominant teacher modes at the expense of diversity across samples. We introduce Posterior Matching Distillation (PMD), a new member of the distribution-based distillation family that combines mode-covering posterior sampling with any-step generation. At zero population loss, PMD recovers the teacher's full posterior of clean images at each trained noise level. Its stochastic student supports any-step sampling budgets within the trained timestep grid without further training. To learn these posteriors, PMD matches exponentially reweighted averages of student samples conditioned on a fixed noisy state to corresponding teacher posterior means. Under Gaussian corruption, exponentially tilted posterior mean is a single teacher evaluation at a shifted input. We prove that, matching tilted means over an open neighborhood uniquely identifies the full posterior. PMD thus supervises the entire conditional distribution through a family of mean constraints, without any auxiliary student-score network. Experiments on SDXL and FLUX.2 [klein] 4B demonstrate that PMD achieves the best FID among 4-step methods on both models, while maintaining competitive or leading performance across prompt-alignment and perceptual-quality metrics.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Posterior Matching Distillation（PMD），以指数重加权的后验均值约束在多个噪声层级上匹配教师完整后验，使学生可任意步数采样；在 SDXL 与 FLUX.2 上取得 4 步方法中最好的 FID。
AI.relevance_reason: 其用一族均值约束监督整条条件分布、避免 mode-seeking 塌缩，并让训练后可支持任意步数预算，可能为 LVR 中多假设 latent 状态的分布级训练与动态计算预算提供借鉴线索，需核查能否迁至序列式推理状态。
